name: tt_tile
title: Tiny Tapeout tile
description: A project with Tiny Tapeout's interface (tt_um_ and its eight ports) on a 1x1 tile's fixed die, 161 x 111.52 µm on sky130. To submit to a shuttle, move the Verilog into Tiny Tapeout's own template repository, which adds their exact pin positions.
teaches: A fixed interface and die, pins on one edge (IO_PIN_ORDER_CFG), and a shuttle's conventions.
